text: surface event ref (commit hash) in text views and document commit-then-close ordering

Forward note from field session: once ref is surfaced in text views, the short hash becomes a pointer into code history, so a later squash/rebase/gc can orphan it — and a surfaced hash that no longer resolves looks broken in a way the json-only version never did. Render defensively: mark/abbreviate when `git cat-file -e <hash>` fails rather than printing a dead hash. Not a blocker, but the failure mode that shows up six months later on a rebased branch.
